items.recipe: Make the production/staging perf runner verify deploy parity automatically before launching browsers for external `--check --base=...` runs, with an explicit escape hatch for diagnostic runs.
items.measurementPlan: Run deploy parity against production, syntax-check the perf runner, and verify low-disk failure still stops before browser launch with a clearer diagnostic.

items.recipe: Add a read-only disk-headroom diagnostic that reports free space and project-local generated cleanup candidates, then point perf preflight failures at it.
items.measurementPlan: Run the diagnostic in JSON mode and confirm it exits nonzero under the current low-disk condition without deleting anything.
